# Offline replay fixtures

The Titanic, House Prices and Spaceship Titanic CSV files are original deterministic synthetic examples generated by `scripts/generate_replay_fixtures.py`. They contain no copied competition rows or real passenger records. The generator uses only Python's standard library, fixed seeds, invented identifiers and simple feature/target rules; it never reads downloaded data or contacts a service.

The existing column names and row counts are retained: 200 training rows per suite, plus 40 Spaceship Titanic test/submission rows. Missing numeric values, categorical values and both classification labels exercise the preprocessing and output contracts. These examples test the evaluation pipeline; they cannot estimate performance on a competition or reproduce historical leaderboard results.

```sh
python scripts/generate_replay_fixtures.py
python scripts/generate_replay_fixtures.py --check
python -m pytest tests/test_synthetic_replay_fixtures.py tests/test_m13_e2e.py tests/test_m9_e2e.py
```

Fixture version: `synthetic-2026-10-22`. The three replay suites use version `0.2.0`; older `0.1.0` scores used different fixtures and must not be compared as model improvements or regressions. Historical milestone documents describe the data available when they were written, not these replacement fixtures.
